name: ProcurementExpress.com
summary: ProcurementExpress.com prices by monthly purchasing volume rather than by user. Basic costs $415 a month for up to $10,000 of purchases, Better $900 for up to $1 million and Best $2,550 for up to $10 million. A 14-day trial needs no credit card.

facts.text: The features page says approved purchase orders sync to QuickBooks Online, invoices become bills, and paying the bill in QuickBooks marks the purchase order paid.
Approval settings named on the features page include automatic or manual routing, approval limits and self-approval rules.
The pricing page ties each plan to a monthly purchasing cap: $10,000 on Basic, $1 million on Better, $10 million on Best and $50 million on Enterprise.
Amazon punch-outs start on Better, and punch-outs for more than 100 stores start on Best.
The security page states a SOC 2 Type II report covering April 18, 2024 to April 17, 2025.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Up to $10,000 of purchases a month. QuickBooks integration

plans.name: Better
plans.notes: Up to $1 million a month. Adds Sage 50 and Amazon punch-outs

plans.name: Best
plans.notes: Up to $10 million a month and up to 5 organizations. Adds a dedicated implementer and scan and match

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Up to $50 million a month. Adds NetSuite, Dynamics and Okta or Azure sign-in

hiddenCosts: Plans are capped by monthly purchase volume, so a growing company moves up a tier even with the same headcount.
The page offers 501(c)(3) nonprofits special pricing through sales, with no amount published.
